sloka: धिगस्तु मम वीर्येण यस्त्वं जीवसि रावण ।सकृत्तु प्रहरेदानीं दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे ।ततस्त्वां मामिका मुष्टिर्नयिष्यति यमक्षयम् ।। ६.५९.६६ ।।।।
transliteration: dhigastu mama vīryeṇa yastvaṁ jīvasi rāvaṇa ।sakṛttu praharedānīṁ durbuddhe kiṁ vikatthase ।tatastvāṁ māmikā muṣṭirnayiṣyati yamakṣayam ।। 6.59.66 ।।।।

translations.english: "O evil minded one, why do you brag You do this once more I will strike you once again with my fist and send you to the abode of Yama."
